jurisdictions.name: Alabama
jurisdictions.military_retirement_tax_rule: Alabama exempts military retirement pay from state income tax for retirees age 55+ (phased implementation; verify current year thresholds).
jurisdictions.va_disability_tax_rule: Alabama does not tax VA disability compensation; state law mirrors federal treatment.
jurisdictions.property_tax_benefits_summary: Alabama offers homestead exemptions for disabled veterans (100% rated) and surviving spouses; additional exemptions for veterans over 65. County assessors administer programs. ADVA coordinates certification.
jurisdictions.education_benefits_summary: Alabama G.I. Dependents' Scholarship Program provides tuition assistance at state institutions for dependents of disabled or deceased veterans. Alabama National Guard Education Assistance Program supports Guard members. Veterans may use federal GI Bill at public and private institutions statewide.
jurisdictions.veterans_home_summary: Alabama operates three state veterans homes: Bill Nichols (Alexander City), Floyd E. 'Tut' Fann (Huntsville), and Colonel Robert L. Howard (Pell City). Skilled nursing and domiciliary care available. ADVA manages admissions.
jurisdictions.notes: Pilot jurisdiction for VetBuddy deep-dive content, county VSO mapping, and benefits verification workflows. Alabama data includes expanded summaries for state veterans homes, property tax exemptions, ADVA programs, and integration with Alabama Career Center veteran services. All figures remain placeholder until live verification.
jurisdictions.employment_support_summary: Alabama provides veterans preference in state employment, career counseling through Alabama Career Centers, and specialized programs via ADVA and Alabama Department of Labor. Private employer tax credits may apply.
